instrument: Information Technology Act 2000 s.79 and IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules 2021
obligation_summary: Safe-harbour due diligence: publish terms, privacy policy and user rules; appoint a grievance officer; acknowledge and resolve user complaints within set timelines; act on lawful orders
applies_to_beatmind_when: BeatMind hosts user content (public song pages) for Indian users

instrument: IT Rules amendments on synthetically generated information (notified 2026-02-10; in force 2026-02-20)
obligation_summary: Prominently label synthetic audio; embed permanent metadata or provenance markers with unique identifiers; do not allow markers to be removed; deploy technical measures against prohibited synthetic content; act on government or court orders within 3 hours
applies_to_beatmind_when: BeatMind offers tools that generate synthetic audio for Indian users
counsel_review: Required: confirm label format for audio

instrument: IT Rules: significant social media intermediary duties
obligation_summary: Additional duties incl. user declaration and verification of synthetic content
applies_to_beatmind_when: Only above 5 million registered users in India

instrument: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025 (notified November 2025; phased over 12 to 18 months)
obligation_summary: Notice and consent; verifiable parental consent for children (under 18); reasonable security safeguards; breach intimation to the Board and affected users; erasure and retention limits; grievance redress; penalties up to ₹250 crore per breach
applies_to_beatmind_when: Processing personal data of users in India
evidence: Externally sourced (rules, penalty); Assumption (child age definition)

instrument: Copyright Act 1957; DPIIT working paper on generative AI and copyright (December 2025, under consultation)
obligation_summary: Avoid infringing outputs; authorship of computer-generated works rests with the person who causes the work to be created (s.2(d)(vi)) [to confirm]; AI training exceptions unsettled
applies_to_beatmind_when: All generated outputs and model use

instrument: Consumer Protection Act 2019; Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020; Guidelines on dark patterns (2023)
obligation_summary: Clear seller details and prices incl. taxes; grievance officer; no subscription traps or drip pricing; easy cancellation

instrument: Goods and Services Tax
obligation_summary: Register; charge GST on subscriptions (Suno's Indian prices include 18% GST, SRC-111); file returns
applies_to_beatmind_when: Indian entity selling to Indian users

instrument: RBI framework for e-mandates on recurring card and UPI payments
obligation_summary: Additional factor of authentication at mandate set-up; pre-debit notification; limits above which each charge needs authentication
source: Analyst knowledge; handled largely by the payment provider

instrument: Personality and publicity rights (case law)
obligation_summary: Do not imitate the voice, name or likeness of identifiable persons without consent; Indian courts have granted injunctions to performers against AI voice imitation [to confirm cases]

instrument: Companies Act 2013; foreign investment rules (FEMA) for fundraising
obligation_summary: Incorporation, statutory filings; compliant issue of shares to foreign investors

instrument: AI Act Article 50 (applies from 2026-08-02; watermark sub-obligation runway to 2026-12-02)
obligation_summary: Providers of systems generating synthetic audio must mark outputs in a machine-readable, detectable format; deployers must disclose deepfakes; fines up to €15M or 3% of turnover
applies_to_beatmind_when: Placing the generator on the EU market or serving EU users

instrument: General Data Protection Regulation
obligation_summary: Lawful basis, transparency, data subject rights, DPIA where high risk, EU representative if no EU establishment, transfer safeguards
applies_to_beatmind_when: Offering services to people in the EU

instrument: Digital Services Act
obligation_summary: Notice-and-action for illegal content, statements of reasons, points of contact; lighter duties for micro and small enterprises
applies_to_beatmind_when: Hosting user content for EU users

instrument: Consumer law on digital content and VAT
obligation_summary: Withdrawal-right rules for digital content; VAT on digital services (merchant of record handles VAT collection)

obligation_summary: Purely AI-generated material is not protected; human expressive contributions, selection and arrangement may be

instrument: DMCA s.512 safe harbour
obligation_summary: Designate an agent with the Copyright Office; notice-and-takedown; repeat-infringer policy
applies_to_beatmind_when: Hosting user content accessible in the US
